claims.statement: 工作区工具链为 Node/pnpm；pnpm install 安装固定 Bruno CLI，API 比较及测试另需显式 api:setup 安装原生 oasdiff。

pnpm-workspace.yaml sets nodeLinker hoisted because Electron Forge's flora-colossus does not follow pnpm symlinks, disables blockExoticSubdeps for electron-winstaller's git dependency, approves six lifecycle-script packages, and exempts the exact @earendil-works/pi-* 1.5.2 versions from the release-age quarantine.

Nx infers typecheck/build from @nx/js/typescript, lint from the ESLint plugin, dev/preview from Vite and test plus per-file test-ci targets from Vitest; test depends on ^build, and the production input excludes specs, eslint configs and test setup.

Workspace packages export a @evidence-poc/source condition pointing at src before types/import, and tsconfig.base.json sets customConditions to the same name, so the type checker reads sources without a paths table.
model-core测试现在显式source条件；desktop按browser/SSR条件解析，其他无条件项目依^build，配置不应一概而论。

@nx/enforce-module-boundaries allows type:app to depend only on type:lib and type:lib only on type:lib, which is what stops a library from importing the Electron main process after the hoisted linker made undeclared imports resolvable.
desktop build 直接运行 electron-forge package，package 为依 build 的 noop alias，make 依 build；start 与双 tsc typecheck 手写，无 prepare-resources。
Forge packages with asar enabled, Vite entries for main, preload and the main_window renderer, Squirrel/ZIP/RPM/DEB makers, and macOS signing/notarization only when APPLE_ID is set.

The main Vite config sets rolldownOptions.platform to node so import.meta.url survives CJS output and createRequire works, and preload pins the emitted entry file name to preload.js because Forge names bundles after the entry.

The release workflow builds a four-way matrix (macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, Linux x64), installs rpm/fakeroot/dpkg on Linux, runs desktop:make per architecture, collects zip/exe/nupkg/RELEASES/deb/rpm artifacts and publishes a GitHub Release.
pnpm 工作区包含应用、领域库和嵌套桌面库，使用根 lockfile 与固定版本工具链。
workspace-layout 记录应用、桌面功能、共享工具与验收运行时的依赖边界，CLI 作为独立应用组合库。
边界由type/layer/platform/surface/scope tags决定，包含cli scope/app，browser-safe子入口仍是特例而非Node root许可。

Because the hoisted linker lets an undeclared import resolve, the @nx/dependency-checks rule configured in each project's eslint.config.mjs (together with the workspace:* protocol) is the guard against missing or unused dependency declarations.

nx.json lists tools/eslint/**/* in namedInputs.sharedGlobals so an edit to a shared lint rule invalidates cached lint results, and its production input excludes specs, eslint configs, tsconfig.spec.json, test setup and src/test/** so test-only changes do not invalidate production builds.
desktop build 直接 Forge package，不等待 lib build，因为 Vite source condition 读取 src；make 输出 out/make，package 为 build alias。
Forge asar=true，使用 main/preload/main_window Vite entry；签名/notarize 仅 APPLE_ID 存在启用，Squirrel/ZIP/RPM/DEB makers，无旧 workbench extraResource。

The main Vite config must set rolldownOptions.platform to 'node' because Forge's Vite plugin emits CJS without build.ssr and Vite 8 would otherwise turn import.meta.url into undefined and break createRequire, and the preload config pins output.entryFileNames to preload.js because Forge names bundles after the entry file.
构建 CLI 后，根 evidence 与 inspect/export/diff 快捷脚本均运行 apps/cli/dist/cli.js；typecheck 通过 Nx target 执行。
browser-platform 规则拒绝 Node builtins 及 API/acceptance/Agent 的 Node roots，只允许明确 browser-safe 子入口；每个 browser 项目须导入规则，tag 本身不拦 builtin。

libs/evidence-model-core/src/purity.spec.ts bundles the package with Vite and a resolver plugin that throws on any Node builtin, so a universal library cannot quietly acquire a Node-only import even where the lint rule is absent.
boundaries:drill 植入七种禁止 import 并执行 uncached lint/核对消息，finally 清 probe，覆盖 projection/acceptance、browser runtime/builtin、tools/SDK 与 scope 反向边。
CI 用 Node 22 冻结安装并查验工作区 Bruno CLI，显式准备 oasdiff 与独立 Fastify，再运行原生测试、边界验证、lint/typecheck/test、CLI 检查、示例只读核验和桌面构建。

The release workflow builds a four-way matrix (macOS arm64, macOS x64, Windows x64, Linux x64), installs rpm/fakeroot/dpkg on Linux, runs nx run desktop:make with an arch argument, collects .zip, .exe, .nupkg, RELEASES, .deb and .rpm from apps/desktop/out/make, and publishes a GitHub Release; Apple secrets are optional, so macOS artifacts are unsigned without them.
OpenWiki 工作流固定0.9.0，当前 schedule 暂停且无本地自动 hook；host 原生生命周期 begin→plan→逐页submit→finish 统一完成 Claims/index/provenance。
